global.title: Trump threatens major escalation in Iran as war nears 5 ...
global.summary: The Iran conflict remains volatile as oil prices surged above $100 before easing, the UN warned the region is nearing catastrophe, and fighting has widened to key shipping corridors including the Red Sea.
global.whyItMatters: This shapes prayer, preaching, and pastoral care as people process fear, instability, and the human cost of war.

global.title: Conflict in Syria | Global Conflict Tracker
global.summary: Syria’s fragile transition continues with sectarian tensions, ISIS activity, Israeli strikes, and new signs of international re-engagement as the EU restores economic cooperation.
global.whyItMatters: It offers a wider lens on instability in the Middle East and helps frame informed intercession for peace and vulnerable communities.

global.title: Nurses put wedding together in 24 hours for bride undergoing brain surgery
global.summary: Hospital staff rallied in a single day to help a bride marry before brain surgery, offering a rare story of compassion and dignity in the middle of crisis.
global.whyItMatters: This is a vivid pastoral illustration of mercy, community, and love shown under pressure.

canadian.title: Today’s News Headlines: Donald Trump vows retaliatory tariffs - Sky News Australia
canadian.summary: A fresh trade warning aimed at Canada signals possible new tariff pressure from the U.S., adding uncertainty for the Canadian economy and cross-border relations.
canadian.whyItMatters: Economic strain quickly becomes a pastoral issue for families facing anxiety over jobs, prices, and business stability.

canadian.title: LeBron James' 'last' NBA move - Reuters
canadian.summary: Alongside broader Reuters headlines, Prime Minister Carney is shown saying Canada will do “whatever it takes” in a trade war with the U.S., underscoring the seriousness of the dispute.
canadian.whyItMatters: National trade tensions can affect congregants’ livelihoods and confidence, especially in export-dependent communities.

local.title: 'We just got a random vehicle in the middle of the runway:' Motorhome crashes through fence at Abbotsford airport - Vancouver Sun
local.summary: A motorhome broke through the perimeter fence and onto an active runway at Abbotsford airport, disrupting operations before the driver, a 53-year-old Abbotsford man, was arrested. No injuries were reported.
local.whyItMatters: It is a significant local public-safety story and a reminder to pray for first responders, travelers, and community calm.

persecutedChurch.title: EU urges Pakistan to act after 13-year-old Christian girl forced to convert - The Jerusalem Post
persecutedChurch.summary: European lawmakers are pressing Pakistan to act after a 13-year-old Christian girl was abducted, forcibly converted, and married to her captor, highlighting the ongoing vulnerability of minority girls.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: This is a clear call to prayer for justice, protection of the vulnerable, and endurance for Christian minorities under pressure.

persecutedChurch.title: Woman seriously injured in knife attack during church service in Irish town - New York Post
persecutedChurch.summary: A woman in her 50s was seriously injured in a knife attack during a Catholic Mass in Tramore, Ireland, before police arrested a man nearby.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: Violence in a worship setting reminds pastors to pray for the safety of congregations and the healing of traumatized communities.

leadership.title: Why Traditional Change Leadership Isn’t Enough When Change Never Stops - Forbes
leadership.summary: This piece argues that constant change requires more than strategy; leaders need self-awareness, emotional regulation, trust-building, and healthy accountability to guide people well.
leadership.whyItMatters: It is a useful prompt for pastoral leadership in a season when churches also face ongoing change, fatigue, and uncertainty.

goodNews.title: Good News: Meet the airport worker going the extra mile - NBC News
goodNews.summary: An airport luggage worker is being recognized for going above and beyond to reconnect travelers with lost luggage tags, turning an ordinary job into a ministry of care.
goodNews.whyItMatters: It is a simple, encouraging example of everyday faithfulness and service that can resonate deeply in pastoral ministry.
